items.question: In how many womb-diagrams are beings said to be tormented?
items.inference: The verse states eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams as sites of torment.
uncertainties: exact gender of pīḍitāḥ is not fully resolved
whether caturaśīti is declined or indeclinable is unclear
items.plain_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
